arStrings.szText: The saboteur has been identified—now, they must be found.

Ouna hoped to save her friends—the heads of the Tree—from their fate to hang from its branches forever. A noble aim, but a deadly one, too. I should see if Gelena has made any progress in finding Ouna's present whereabouts.
Speak with Gelena by the Tree of Whispers
Ouna plans to sever the heads' bonds to the Tree, even at the cost of all the lives the ensuing rot would take. She must be confronted.
The head we retrieved from Ouna's Hideout let slip that Ouna has another den in the Cindered Wastes. Caidin took off immediately to find her. We'll have to track him down.
Search for Caidin in the Wastes with Gelena

Ouna has obscured the location of her hideout. I'll need to tear down her illusions again.
